_note: Cutscenes (src/systems/cutscene.ts). Steps run in order: fade, caption (letterbox text), say (a spoken line), camera (pan to a ground point or back to the player), wait, setFlag, startQuest, run (game actions, src/engine/game.js runAction: go, time, flag, refresh, give, take, equip, strip, heal, banner and so on, separated by ';'). [PLAYER] is the character's name. startFade 1 opens on black. Line IDs are MAIN_QUEST.md's. Escape skips a scene but still applies every flag, quest and action.

steps.caption: [PLAYER]. A goat farmer on the Sentinel Coast, with a wife, a daughter and a dog.
Fourth Era, 201. Hammerfell won its war with the Dominion alone, and has been paying for it since.
Dawn. The salt pans glitter below the hill. The goats are complaining.

steps.run: time 19; go farmhouse 130 140; flag evening.begun; refresh

steps.caption: Home before dark. Nadira has the lamp lit. Tavi has been waiting by the door with something behind her back.
He tells Tavi the story of the gull who got lost. He gets the ending wrong. She corrects him, twice.
Day two.

steps.run: time day+1 6; go farmhouse 196 120; flag day2; give Bandage 2; refresh

say.speaker: Nadira
say.text: The boar's been in the barley again. Dune's beside himself. Take the knife, and come back with both your hands.

steps.caption: A line of riders on the coast road. Not tax riders. Clean coats, good horses.
They stop at the farm gate. One of them waves.

steps.run: time 12; flag guest.arrived; go farmhouse 150 140; refresh

steps.caption: Midday. A big man in a clean coat gets down first and takes his hat off. He is delighted to be here.

say.speaker: The stranger
say.text: I did try to be pleasant. People always make me do it the hard way.

steps.run: flag kerrash.left; flag salt.table; time 21; refresh

steps.caption: He rides out. The little white mound of salt stays on the table. Nobody touches it.

say.speaker: Nadira
say.text: Leave it. I'll clean it in the morning. Go to bed. Please.

steps.caption: The dog barks.
Torches on the road. He takes the old knife from under the bed.

steps.run: time 2; go coast 1250 1516; equip IronDagger; flag night.fight; nightFight; refresh

say.speaker: Nadira
say.text: Keep the door. Tavi, under the bed. Now.

steps.caption: He is hit from behind. His knees go.
A big man steps over him. A hammer on his shoulder, and a face he will remember for the rest of his life.

say.speaker: Nadira
say.text: I'm sorry. I should have told you. Find Zeyna.

steps.caption: A dog's last cry. A door. A child's voice, saying 'Da?'. Then a silence that is worse.

say.speaker: Kerrash
say.text: I'm going to let you live. Somebody ought to know what happens, and it can't be a stranger.

steps.caption: A pinch of salt in his mouth. The smell of a heated iron.

say.speaker: Kerrash
say.text: Burn it. The dog's made his point.

steps.caption: The carved gull on the floor, one wing crooked. His hand moves toward it.

steps.run: flag night.over; flag farm.burned; flag family.gone; unflag night.fight; unflag dune.follow; unflag salt.table; strip; take IronDagger; take CarvedGull; heal; dynamicClear

steps.caption: HAMMERFELL
Act One. Waking.
Four more names. Two more folios: one with an Alik'r caravan elder, Mother Anwar, one with an advocate in Sentinel, Leyla Rasul.
A road leads inland to a ferry, and a smuggler captain called Juma Redtide.
The coast is yours to walk for now. Act Two is still being built.
